hook: Our story is to begin in the small resolute  village of Jalanthar. This small village of some 300 souls features a number of humans, elves halflings and 3 or 4 half-orcs.
threats: The character with the highest roll, will notice in the distance to the north, moving through the field towards the wagon, three orc’s
4 wolves attack the last character in the woods
1 owlbear attacks from some small brush
1 brown bear attacks from the mouth of its cave
Four arrows stand driven partially on the road in a diamond shape. Atop each arrow is the head of a large rat
rewards: amethyst crystal the size of a man’s thumb
